facts.activity_file: setting and proving mechanical seal support systems
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setpoint on TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 1 April 2011 a corrective action on TH-3240, LT-3240 and M-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical safeguard it was raised to restore.
